limitations: Partial blind only: segment counts/shape visible; arm identity, case category, policy, hypothesis, expected winner unknown and not sought; read-only on the two supplied packets only (no other files, provenance, internet, or other agents); single rater, no inter-rater agreement.

Formal ratings: both candidates unavailable in all 12 cases ⇒ main meaning and readability unjudgeable; 0 scores are unavailable bookkeeping placeholders, not quality scores; absolute severe errors not assessable; source_facts_valid false only because no valid consumable output exists; empty relative lists are contract bookkeeping, not evidence of parity.

Diagnostic is posthoc and exploratory on outputs that failed the predeclared machine contract: not a preregistered pass, no machine validity claimed, no promotion of failed outputs, no formal E1 semantic win, no authorization of any next step, and no causal inference beyond this 12-case sample.

Diagnostic scope: main meaning only; readability and segment count were not scored (readability_preference recorded as unjudgeable = not assessed here); merged segments were not treated as automatic meaning harm.

source_facts_valid checked absolutely per the frozen fact wording: false only where the fact table explicitly asserts turn/role structure (5e49effe X, 69fef2af X, 6e553bfb Y, 3ad9f7db X) that the candidate's segment text does not carry; this structural check is kept separate from the meaning preference.

Severity bar: only the four packet kinds (negation/agreement reversal, invention, omission, wrong claim ownership), flagged only for textually observable deviations from the accepted source (e.g., a dropped numeral); ambiguous ASR-garbled wording is hedged in uncertainty instead of flagged; identical raw text + shape pairs (6b59aae3, cf1ab1ad, 63274db8, cf943212) can show no new severe error and no win.

Korean quotes are this rater's reading; absolute-meaning confidence is most limited for 5e49effe (ASR number wording), 3ad9f7db (incomplete final turn), cf943212 (unresolved overlap); no case blocked the relative comparison, so no diagnostic row uses 'unjudgeable' for meaning.
